annotations.title: Reconcile an account against a bank figure

description: Compare an account against the balance a bank reports, and list what might explain the difference. Reads only; books nothing.

as_of.description: Date the bank figure is from (YYYY-MM-DD or "today"). Defaults to today. Transactions after this date are not counted in the balance.

balance_counts.description: Which transactions the balance counts. "all" (default) counts uncleared rows too, which is right when uncleared means nobody ticked it off rather than the bank has not posted it. "cleared_only" counts only cleared rows.

expected_balance.description: Balance the bank reports for this account (human amount, e.g., 12345.67)

lookback_days.description: How far back to look for candidates, in days. Defaults to 90.

name: reconcile_account
